d: Flávio Bolsonaro has reportedly left Brazil just 48 hours after losing the presidential election to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, travelling through Argentina before flying to Ecuador, amid speculation that he may head to the United States. His departure comes as he faces a money-laundering investigation and questions over a Supreme Court order to surrender his passport. Lula has criticised his decision to leave the country, while Flávio has rejected the election result and threatened legal action.
